Blocks.Text: Usage of this API is restricted to approved partners, subject to limitations via API agreement.

Blocks.Section: Group Posts and their Social Actions
Blocks.Text: LinkedIn's Group Posts and their Social Actions rely on the following APIs:

Blocks.Section: Group Posts and their Social Actions
Blocks.Text:
UGC Post API
Social Actions APIs

Blocks.Section: Utilizing UGC Post API for Groups
SectionPath: Utilizing UGC Post API for Groups
Blocks.Text: All Group posts will contain a group URNin the containerEntityfield. Group posts are represented as groupPost URN.

SectionPath: Utilizing UGC Post API for Groups
Utilizing UGC Post API for Groups
Utilizing UGC Post API for Groups
Utilizing UGC Post API for Groups
Blocks.Text:
GET /ugcPosts to retrieve a single group post via the groupPostUrn
FINDER "containerEntities" /ugcPosts  to get all posts of a Group
FINDER "authors" /ugcPosts  to get all posts of a member. Posts include public and group shares. They are differentiated by the containerEntityfield.

Blocks.Section: Utilizing Social Actions APIs for Groups
SectionPath: Utilizing Social Actions APIs for Groups
Blocks.Text: All Group social actions will be retrieved the same way as any other social actions. Simply use the Social Actions API with the groupPostUrn.

Blocks.Section: Utilizing Compliance Events API for Group Content
SectionPath: Utilizing Compliance Events API for Group Content
Blocks.Text: All Group content activities involving posts and social actions made by a regulated member will appear on Compliance Events API. It will be surfaced through the resourceName:

Blocks.Section: Utilizing Compliance Events API for Group Content
SectionPath: Utilizing Compliance Events API for Group Content
Blocks.Text:
ugcPosts  - will contain containerEntity
socialActions  - will be ugcPostUrnthat links to a group post

Blocks.Section: Utilizing Compliance Events API for Group Content
SectionPath: Utilizing Compliance Events API for Group Content
Blocks.Text: Group content activities made by non-regulated members within a group owned by a regulated member are currently not captured through Compliance Events. Please use UGC Posts and Social Actions APIs to retrieve this information.

SectionPath: ID Migration from V1 to V2
Blocks.Text:
V1 format:  g-{groupID}-S-{postID}
V2 format:  urn:li:groupPost:{groupID}-{postID}
